## Examing Distance Decay Relationship (DDR) between community and environmental distance

# Retrieve and set the working directory
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
getwd()
setwd("~/GitHub/irrigation/Beta_diversity")
```

# Load packages

```{r}
require("simba")
require("fossil")
```

# Import soil properties and metadata

```{r}
env1 <- read.csv("./Distance_decay_relationships/Data/Soil properties_for_DDR.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
design1 <- read.csv("./Distance_decay_relationships/Data/Metadata_Irrigation.manipulative.exper.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
env2 <- env1[rownames(env1) %in% rownames(design1),]
design <- design1[rownames(env2),]
env <- env2  # remove the two Nebraska samples
```

# Choose irrigated and non-irrigated samples

```{r}
design.irr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "irrigated") 
design.unirr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "non-irrigated")
env.irr <- env[rownames(env) %in% rownames(design.irr),]
env.unirr <- env[rownames(env) %in% rownames(design.unirr),]
```


# Soil physicochemical data used for analysis

```{r}
env.dat <- as.matrix(env[,c(3:16, 18:29)])
env.dat.irr <- as.matrix(env.irr[,c(3:16, 18:29)])
env.dat.unirr <- as.matrix(env.unirr[,c(3:16, 18:29)])

# standardization
env.scale <- scale(env.dat, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
env.scale.irr <- scale(env.dat.irr, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
env.scale.unirr <- scale(env.dat.unirr, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
```


# Conduct PCA

```{r}
library(vegan)
pca <- rda(env.scale)
summary(pca)
scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pca, choices = 1:10)$sites)
env.dist <- vegdist(scores, "euclidean") 
env.dist <- env.dist/max(env.dist)
env.dist[which(!is.finite(env.dist))] = NA

pca.irr <- rda(env.scale.irr)
summary(pca.irr)
scores.irr <- as.data.frame(scores(pca.irr, choices = 1:6)$sites)
env.dist.irr <- vegdist(scores.irr, "euclidean")
env.dist.irr <- env.dist.irr/max(env.dist.irr)
env.dist.irr[which(!is.finite(env.dist.irr))] = NA

pca.unirr <- rda(env.scale.unirr)
summary(pca.unirr)
scores.unirr <- as.data.frame(scores(pca.unirr, choices = 1:5)$sites)
env.dist.unirr <- vegdist(scores.unirr, "euclidean")
env.dist.unirr <- env.dist.unirr/max(env.dist.unirr)
env.dist.unirr[which(!is.finite(env.dist.unirr))] = NA
```

# Taxonomic profiles in irrigated and unirrigated farms

```{r}
com1 <- read.csv("./Distance_decay_relationships/Data/RPKM.species.abundance.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
com <- com1[,rownames(env.dat)]
com.irr <- com1[,rownames(env.dat.irr)]
com.irr <- com.irr[rowSums(com.irr)>20,] 
com.unirr <- com1[,rownames(env.dat.unirr)]
com.unirr <- com.unirr[rowSums(com.unirr)>20,] 

bray.dist <- 1 - vegdist(t(com), method = "bray")
bray.dist.irr <- 1 - vegdist(t(com.irr), method = "bray")
bray.dist.unirr <- 1 - vegdist(t(com.unirr), method = "bray")
```

# Regression between Bray-Curtis and environmental distance

```{r}
# Overall model
DD.env <- lm(bray.dist ~ env.dist)
summary(DD.env, correlation = TRUE) # r2=0.045, P= 0.003, slope = -0.162

# non-irrigated samples
DD.env.unirr <- lm(bray.dist.unirr ~ env.dist.unirr)
summary(DD.env.unirr, correlation = TRUE) # r2=0.219, P= 0.002, slope = -0.337

# irrigated samples
DD.env.irr <- lm(bray.dist.irr ~ env.dist.irr)
summary(DD.env.irr, correlation = TRUE) # r2=0.015, P=0.201, slope = -0.080
```


# Plot DDR of overall model

```{r}
clr <- colorRampPalette(c("#00007F", "blue", "#007FFF", "cyan", "#7FFF7F", "yellow", "#FF7F00", "red", "#7F0000"))
#png(filename=file, width=5, height=5, units="in", res=600, pointsize=10)
#par(mfrow=c(2, 2), mar = c(5,5,3,1), oma =c(0,0,4,0))

par(mfrow=c(1, 1), mar = c(5,5,3,1), oma =c(0,0,4,0))

# Make Plot for total community (geo)
slope1 <- round(coefficients(DD.env)[2], 3)
int1 <- round(coefficients(DD.env)[1], 3)
p <- round(summary(DD.env)$coefficients[8],3)
colors <- densCols(env.dist, bray.dist, colramp=clr)
plot(env.dist, bray.dist, ylab="Taxonomic similarity", pch=20,
     xlab="Environmental distance", col = colors, cex=1.4, cex.lab=1.3)
title(paste("Total: slope = ", slope1, "\n R2=0.045, p = 0.003"), line = 1, cex=1)
abline(DD.env, col = "black", lwd=3.5)
```

# tested whether differences in slopes and intercepts of DDRs

```{r}
# tested whether differences in slopes and intercepts of
# DDRs were statistically significant using a permutation-based
# linear regression approach
# Add X-Axis Label to Plot

a.dd <- 'y'

if(a.dd == 'y'){
  clr <- colorRampPalette(c("#00007F", "blue", "#007FFF",
                            "cyan", "#7FFF7F", "yellow",
                            "#FF7F00", "red", "#7F0000"))

  png("./Distance_decay_relationships/Output/DDR_environment_taxonomic.png", width = 3200, height = 1600, res = 300)
  
  par(mfrow=c(1, 2), mar=c(5,5,3,1), oma=c(3,0,3,0))

  # Make Plot for unirrigated (env)
  slope2 <- round(coefficients(DD.env.unirr)[2], 3)
  int2 <- round(coefficients(DD.env.unirr)[1], 3)
  p <- round(summary(DD.env.unirr)$coefficients[8], 3)

  colors <- densCols(env.dist.unirr, bray.dist.unirr, colramp=clr)

  plot(env.dist.unirr, bray.dist.unirr,
       ylab="Taxonomic similarity", pch=20,
       xlim=c(0, 1),
       xlab="Environmental distance",
       col=colors, cex=1.7, cex.lab=1.2)

  title(paste("Unirrigated: slope = ", slope2,
              "\n R2=0.166, p < 0.001"),
        line=1, cex=1)

  abline(DD.env.unirr, col="black", lwd=3)

  # Make Plot for irrigated (env)
  slope3 <- round(coefficients(DD.env.irr)[2], 3)
  int3 <- round(coefficients(DD.env.irr)[1], 3)
  p <- round(summary(DD.env.irr)$coefficients[8], 3)

  colors <- densCols(env.dist.irr, bray.dist.irr, colramp=clr)

  plot(env.dist.irr, bray.dist.irr,
       ylab="Taxonomic similarity", pch=20,
       xlab="Environmental distance",
       col=colors, cex=1.8, cex.lab=1.2)

  title(paste("Irrigated: slope = ", slope3,
              "\n R2=0.060, p < 0.001"),
        line=1, cex=1)

  abline(DD.env.irr, col="black", lwd=3)

  # Statistical comparisons
  d1 <- diffslope(env.dist.unirr, bray.dist.unirr, env.dist.irr, bray.dist.irr, ic=TRUE, permutations=1000)

  d3 <- diffic(env.dist.unirr, bray.dist.unirr, env.dist.irr, bray.dist.irr, resc.y=FALSE, permutations=1000)

  Mtitle <- paste(
    "Bray-Curtis\n",
    round(100 * abs((slope2-slope3) /
          mean(c(slope2, slope3))), 1),
    '% difference in environmental DDRs; p = ',
    d1[3],
    sep=""
  )

  # Add outer labels after plotting
  mtext("Environmental Distance", side=1, adj=0.5, outer=TRUE, line=1)

  title(main=Mtitle, line=0, outer=TRUE, cex.main=1.2)
}

dev.off()
```


# Export coordinates of Environmental DDR for subsequent plots

```{r}
# 1). Export coordinates of Environmental DDR in unirrigated farms for manual pot
env_mat.unirr <- as.matrix(env.dist.unirr)
bray_mat.unirr <- as.matrix(bray.dist.unirr)

# Extract the lower triangle (excluding duplicates and zeros on the diagonal)
lower_tri <- lower.tri(env_mat.unirr, diag = FALSE)
env_vec <- env_mat.unirr[lower_tri]
bray_vec <- bray_mat.unirr[lower_tri]

dist_df <- data.frame(env = env_vec,  bray.taxa = bray_vec)

dist_df.taxon.unirr <- data.frame(env = env_vec, bray = bray_vec)
colnames(dist_df.taxon.unirr) <- c("env.unirr", "bray.taxon.unirr")

write.csv(dist_df, file = "./Distance_decay_relationships/Output/Bray_Taxonomic_Environmental_Unirrigated.csv")


library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())
ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = env, y = bray.taxa)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = TRUE, size = 1.5) + 
  labs(x = "Environmental Distance",
       y = "Taxon's similarity",
       title = "Relationship between Environmental and Taxon's similarity" ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid = element_blank())


# 2). Export coordinates of Environmental DDR in irrigated farms for manual pot
env_mat.irr <- as.matrix(env.dist.irr)
bray_mat.irr <- as.matrix(bray.dist.irr)

# Extract the lower triangle (excluding duplicates and zeros on the diagonal)
lower_tri <- lower.tri(env_mat.irr, diag = FALSE)
env_vec <- env_mat.irr[lower_tri]
bray_vec <- bray_mat.irr[lower_tri]

dist_df <- data.frame(env = env_vec,  bray.taxa = bray_vec)
dist_df.taxon.irr <- data.frame(env = env_vec, bray = bray_vec)
colnames(dist_df.taxon.irr) <- c("env.irr", "bray.taxon.irr")

write.csv(dist_df, file = "./Distance_decay_relationships/Output/Bray_Taxonomic_Environmental_Irrigated.csv")


theme_set(theme_bw())
ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = env, y = bray.taxa)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = TRUE, size = 1.5) + 
  labs(x = "Environmental Distance",
       y = "Taxon's similarity",
       title = "Relationship between Environmental and Taxon's Distance" ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid = element_blank())
```

# Functioinal profiles in irrigated and unirrigated farms

```{r}
com1 <- read.csv("./Distance_decay_relationships/Data/RPKM.KO.abundance_9353.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
com <- com1[,rownames(env.dat)]
com.irr <- com1[,rownames(env.dat.irr)]
com.irr <- com.irr[rowSums(com.irr)>50,] 
com.unirr <- com1[,rownames(env.dat.unirr)]
com.unirr <- com.unirr[rowSums(com.unirr)>50,] 

bray.dist <- 1 - vegdist(t(com), method = "bray")
bray.dist.irr <- 1 - vegdist(t(com.irr), method = "bray")
bray.dist.unirr <- 1 - vegdist(t(com.unirr), method = "bray")
```

# Regression between Bray-Curtis and environmental distance

```{r}
# Overall model
DD.env <- lm(bray.dist ~ env.dist)
summary(DD.env, correlation = TRUE) # r2=0.002, P= 0.573, slope = -0.008

# non-irrigated samples
DD.env.unirr <- lm(bray.dist.unirr ~ env.dist.unirr)
summary(DD.env.unirr, correlation = TRUE) # r2=0.053, P= 0.095, slope = -0.044

# irrigated samples
DD.env.irr <- lm(bray.dist.irr ~ env.dist.irr)
summary(DD.env.irr, correlation = TRUE) # r2=0.054, P=0.068, slope = -0.034
```

# tested whether differences in slopes and intercepts of DDRs

```{r}
# tested whether differences in slopes and intercepts of
# DDRs were statistically significant using a permutation-based
# linear regression approach
# Add X-Axis Label to Plot

a.dd <- 'y'

if(a.dd == 'y'){
  clr <- colorRampPalette(c("#00007F", "blue", "#007FFF",
                            "cyan", "#7FFF7F", "yellow",
                            "#FF7F00", "red", "#7F0000"))

  png("./Distance_decay_relationships/Output/DDR_environment_function.png", width = 3200, height = 1600, res = 300)
  
  par(mfrow=c(1, 2), mar=c(5,5,3,1), oma=c(3,0,3,0))

  # Make Plot for unirrigated (env)
  slope2 <- round(coefficients(DD.env.unirr)[2], 3)
  int2 <- round(coefficients(DD.env.unirr)[1], 3)
  p <- round(summary(DD.env.unirr)$coefficients[8], 3)

  colors <- densCols(env.dist.unirr, bray.dist.unirr, colramp=clr)

  plot(env.dist.unirr, bray.dist.unirr,
       ylab="Functional similarity", pch=20,
       xlim=c(0, 1),
       xlab="Environmental distance",
       col=colors, cex=1.7, cex.lab=1.2)

  title(paste("Unirrigated: slope = ", slope2,
              "\n R2=0.166, p < 0.001"),
        line=1, cex=1)

  abline(DD.env.unirr, col="black", lwd=3)

  # Make Plot for irrigated (env)
  slope3 <- round(coefficients(DD.env.irr)[2], 3)
  int3 <- round(coefficients(DD.env.irr)[1], 3)
  p <- round(summary(DD.env.irr)$coefficients[8], 3)

  colors <- densCols(env.dist.irr, bray.dist.irr, colramp=clr)

  plot(env.dist.irr, bray.dist.irr,
       ylab="Functional similarity", pch=20,
       xlab="Environmental distance",
       col=colors, cex=1.8, cex.lab=1.2)

  title(paste("Irrigated: slope = ", slope3,
              "\n R2=0.060, p < 0.001"),
        line=1, cex=1)

  abline(DD.env.irr, col="black", lwd=3)

  # Statistical comparisons
  d1 <- diffslope(env.dist.unirr, bray.dist.unirr, env.dist.irr, bray.dist.irr, ic=TRUE, permutations=1000)

  d3 <- diffic(env.dist.unirr, bray.dist.unirr, env.dist.irr, bray.dist.irr, resc.y=FALSE, permutations=1000)

  Mtitle <- paste(
    "Bray-Curtis\n",
    round(100 * abs((slope2-slope3) /
          mean(c(slope2, slope3))), 1),
    '% difference in environmental DDRs; p = ',
    d1[3],
    sep=""
  )

  # Add outer labels after plotting
  mtext("Environmental Distance", side=1, adj=0.5, outer=TRUE, line=1)

  title(main=Mtitle, line=0, outer=TRUE, cex.main=1.2)
}

dev.off()
```

# Plot DDR using calculated data above

```{r}
### 3) Function KO ~ Environmental distance across irrigated and unirrigated farms
df.final.ko.env <- read.csv("./Distance_decay_relationships/Output/Bray_Functional_Environmental_Irrigated-Unirrigated.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
head(df.final.ko.env)
irrigation.color <-  c("Irrigated"="#4169B2", "Unirrigated"="#BB2BA0")

theme_set(theme_bw())
p3 <- ggplot(df.final.ko.env, aes(x = env, y = bray.KO, color = type, fill = type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(group = type, color = type), method = "lm", se = TRUE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(x = "Environmental distance",
       y = "Functional similarity",
       title = "Environmental and Functional similarity" ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)
    ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = irrigation.color) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = irrigation.color)

p3

ggsave("./Distance_decay_relationships/Output/DDR between Environmental and Function_Irrigated_Unirrigated.pdf", p3, height = 5.5, width = 7.5)
```

```{r}
### DDR of Taxonomy ~ Environmental distance across irrigated and unirrigated farms
df.final.taxon.env <- read.csv("./Distance_decay_relationships/Output/Bray_Taxonomic_Environmental_Irrigated-Unirrigated.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)

  labs(x = "Environmental distance",
       y = "Taxonomic similarity",
       title = "Relationship between Environmental and Taxon's similarity" ) +

    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)
    ) +

p4
```
